definitions.gloss: deep sea; ocean depths; deep ocean
definitions.explanation: The deepest parts of the ocean, generally considered to be below 200 meters where sunlight does not reach. Used in scientific, documentary, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {深海|しんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are mysterious creatures in the deep sea.

examples.japanese: {深海|しんかい}⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海底|かいてい}→海底：13287_kaitei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧きた。
examples.english: The deep-sea exploration robot sent back footage of the ocean floor.

examples.japanese: {深海|しんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水圧|すいあつ}→水圧：21749_suiatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}る→潜る：03931_moguru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The water pressure in the deep sea is extremely high, and humans cannot dive there directly.

notes:
USAGE:
{深海|しんかい} combines {深|しん} (deep) and {海|かい} (sea). It is commonly used as a modifier in compound expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深海|しんかい}{魚|ぎょ} (deep-sea fish)
- {深海|しんかい}⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧ (deep-sea exploration)
- {深海|しんかい}⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧ (deep-sea organisms)
- {深海|しんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}る→潜る：03931_moguru⟧ (to dive into the deep sea)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{海底|かいてい}→海底：13287_kaitei⟧ means the sea floor or ocean bottom, focusing on the surface rather than the water column. {深海|しんかい} refers to the deep ocean environment as a whole.
